question: Find the top 10 drivers with the fastest lap times in races held at circuits in Italy or UK. For these drivers, list their full names and their fastest lap time in seconds.

  SELECT 
    lt.XCL_044 AS driver_id,
    (CASE WHEN SUBSTRING(lt.XCL_047, 1, INSTR(lt.XCL_047, ':') - 1) <> '' THEN CAST(SUBSTRING(lt.XCL_047, 1, INSTR(lt.XCL_047, ':') - 1) AS REAL) * 60 ELSE 0 END +
